title: Fractional CISO Cost in 2026: Rates and Retainers
summary: Fractional CISO cost in 2026: Managed Comply at $5,000 to $15,000 a month, and public vCISO records from $2,000 a month to $120,253 a year.
body_markdown:
## What is included in a retainer, and what is not?


The ISACA Journal[defines a virtual CISO](https://www.isaca.org/resources/isaca-journal/issues/2022/volume-2/helpsource) as "an information security professional with experience in developing and implementing security frameworks, strategies and programs remotely." Agency's glossary entry for a[virtual CISO](https://getagency.com/glossary/virtual-ciso?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=cta&utm_campaign=vciso&utm_content=fractional-ciso-cost__in_text) covers the role in more detail. In practice a retainer buys leadership:


- security strategy and an annual plan
- risk governance and risk acceptance decisions
- policy ownership and review
- oversight of audits and customer security reviews
- reporting to executives and the board


What it often leaves out is the work underneath. Collecting evidence, fixing failing controls, running access reviews and answering security questionnaires take people, and an advisory retainer assumes you have them. East Palo Alto's request for proposals describes the role as "primarily focused on strategic advisory, governance, policy development, and program oversight," and adds that some tasks may need "hands-on operational support" ([RFP answers](https://www.cityofepa.org/sites/default/files/fileattachments/city_manager039s_office/page/25325/questions_and_answers_vciso.pdf) ).


Regulated companies can use an outside leader. The FTC Safeguards Rule says the designated Qualified Individual "may be employed by you, an affiliate, or a service provider" ([16 CFR 314.4](https://www.ecfr.gov/current/title-16/chapter-I/subchapter-C/part-314/section-314.4) ). Responsibility for oversight stays with the company.


## How does a fractional CISO compare with a full-time hire?


A full-time security leader is paid a salary whether or not there is a full-time job to do. The Bureau of Labor Statistics puts the median wage for computer and information systems managers at $175,140 a year in May 2025 ([BLS](https://www.bls.gov/ooh/management/computer-and-information-systems-managers.htm) ). That occupation is the closest published series; it is not a CISO-only figure.


Two more public numbers frame the range. Texas classifies its state Chief Information Security Officer role at $135,577 to $229,295 a year ([Texas State Auditor's Office](https://hr.sao.texas.gov/Compensation/Archives/2025/JobDescriptions/R0239.pdf) ). And wages are not the whole cost: benefits made up 30.0 percent of employer compensation costs for private industry workers in June 2026 ([BLS](https://www.bls.gov/news.release/ecec.nr0.htm) ).


The comparison that matters is scope. A full-time hire still needs a team or a budget for one. A fractional leader still needs someone to do the work. Agency compares the two models in[vCISO versus full-time CISO](https://getagency.com/vciso-vs-full-time-ciso?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=cta&utm_campaign=vciso&utm_content=fractional-ciso-cost__in_text) .


## How does Managed Comply's published price compare?


Managed Comply is priced by headcount, not hours. Every tier includes a full virtual CISO and up to three standard frameworks, such as SOC 2, ISO 27001 and HIPAA, run by a named Agency team, per[Managed Comply pricing](https://getagency.com/lp/managed-comply-pricing?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=cta&utm_campaign=vciso&utm_content=fractional-ciso-cost__in_text) . Two things are priced on top:


- Dedicated full-time engineers, from $15,000 a month for each engineer, per[the same page](https://getagency.com/lp/managed-comply-pricing?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=cta&utm_campaign=vciso&utm_content=fractional-ciso-cost__in_text) .
- Advanced frameworks such as FedRAMP, CMMC and HITRUST, quoted at scoping.


A GRC platform subscription, if you use one, is also separate. Agency runs the program on the platform you already have.


About 65% of Agency's Managed Comply clients have no full-time security hire. The rest have at least one, and some have a full-time CISO; for those clients Agency's work is usually focused on a specific product organization, department or framework.


## Which model fits which company?


Match the model to the gap.


- **You have a security team and need a leader.** An hourly consultant or advisory retainer fits. Fix the hours in the contract.
- **You have a framework deadline and no team.** Advice will not produce evidence. Buy a program that includes the people, and check which frameworks are covered. If SOC 2 is the deadline, start with[what SOC 2 costs](https://blog.getagency.com/articles/soc-2-cost) ; for ISO 27001, see[ISO 27001 certification cost](https://blog.getagency.com/articles/iso-27001-certification-cost) .
- **You have a security leader and need capacity.** Add engineers under your own leader.
- **You are large enough for a full-time CISO.** Hire one, and decide what stays outsourced. The blog's[vCISO versus CISO guide](https://blog.getagency.com/articles/vciso-vs-ciso) covers that handover.


Before signing any retainer, ask for the named person, the hours each month, the deliverables, and who does the work the leader assigns. Agency answers the pricing question in short form in[how much a vCISO costs](https://getagency.com/questions/how-much-does-a-vciso-cost?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=cta&utm_campaign=vciso&utm_content=fractional-ciso-cost__in_text) .
